attribution: Adapted numerical selection from Ratz, Schram, Sciacchitano and Mendez, Dataset of: On the aerodynamics of an accelerating and decelerating propeller in hover at low Reynolds numbers, version 1.0.0 (2026-10-05).
selection: Existing processed ensemble sample nearest 4000 RPM in each /00,/05,/10 Up and Do trace, within 1 RPM. Authors already interpolated RPM onto the thrust time base; this selector performs no additional interpolation or fit. Descriptive selection, not held-out validation.
scope: External small-electric-propeller processed ensemble means. Not AERIS/DA120 calibration, individual trial data, command latency, or a uniquely identified causal model. No PIV archive is required or inspected.
